scope.summary: Wire the 14.4-owned StudioAdjustment tonal/color adjustment set (Brightness/Contrast, Levels, Curves, Exposure, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Black & White, Photo Filter, Channel Mixer, Color Lookup/LUT, Invert, Posterize, Threshold, Gradient Map, Selective Color, Shadows/Highlights, and the rest) to interleave with StudioLiveFilter nodes in ONE non-destructive stack order sharing the same masking/blend/opacity/enable/re-edit surface. 14.9 does NOT redefine adjustments; an adjustment applied 'as a filter' is the same primitive reached through the effect surface (two entry points, owned by 14.4, hosted here).
acceptance_criteria: 14.4 StudioAdjustment nodes interleave with filters in one order; adjustment-as-filter same primitive; not redefined
expected_tests: test: StudioAdjustment nodes interleave with StudioLiveFilter in one stack order; adjustment-as-filter is same primitive (no redefinition); shared mask/blend/opacity/enable surface

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Adjustments and filters live in separate orders; duplicate adjustment primitive.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
